name: Kiyose Takumi
source:
Tohoku University, First year at Faculty of Economics. Originally from Hokuzumi Academy.

A gentle person who can't say no to a request.

2 years ago when he was a sophomore at Hokuzumi Academy, he is asked to have sex with Akari whom he meet in the town. After that, he became Erika's boyfriend, but the thing he did with Akari become a bad aftertaste in chest as he feels guilty to Erika.

He still haven't been able to talk about that with Akari yet.
